text.p: TrizecHahn Corp on Monday said it completed its previously announced transaction to acquire properties in Germany and Britain from a company controlled by German businessman Dieter Bock.

TrizecHahn said it paid about US$147 million for real estate projects owned by Bock's Advanta Management AG. The properties were paid for through the issuance of about 5.5 million TrizecHahn subordinate voting shares and the assumption of certain development liabilities and contruction financing.

Under the strategic alliance first announced in March, Bock will become president of TrizecHahn Europe and will soon become vice chairman and director of TrizecHahn. The company said Bock will hold an equity stake in TrizecHahn of about four percent as a result of the transaction.

Based in Toronto, TrizecHahn is one of North America's largest publicly traded real estate companies with interests in 68 income producing properties. The company is listed in Toronto, Montreal and New York.
